items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: he said, now that's my friend. So he said, now Walter, give him your guitar

ctx.x: Over at Pickus, Black Walter, they call him?

Yeah, he cat. Walter Nelson. He's a good picker, but of course he, Pico asked him, he says, well, he asked me to, Pico asked me to play something, you know, and they was playing, Pico was playing, and I, I take the guitar, he said, now that's my friend. So he said, now Walter, give him your guitar, because I used to play with Lloyd Allen, and he said, give me, he said, yeah. So anyhow, Pico taken the clarinet and started playing. Pico started playing. Then I started making them double raps. But he got through, he…
You got good remembrance. You know, you got to have that. Yeah, you got that. You got to work on your mind.
